about_the_game:
Explore the Spirit Realm

The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Discover the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

Features

  • Dodge, parry, dash and slash your way through different enemies and bosses.

  • Classic platformer action in a beautiful 2D hand drawn art style.

  • Discover new gates and worlds, all connected together by the spiritual gates of the world.

  • Decide your path. Make new friends. Find the secrets of the Spirit Realm.

  • Learn new arts, skills and equipment. Find your way to you brother, perhaps he knows what is going on? 

  • Hand painted landscapes, every single part of the game hand drawn with care. 

  • Difficult obstacles, bosses, enemies all with varying abilities. Study closely then strike when you are ready.

Hand Drawn with Love

Torii is a game with each art being hand-drawn, from the characters to the entire world itself. There was no other way to express the world and in order to bring it to life, Torii was made with an attention to bring back the traditional hand-drawn 2D art style that pioneered the genre today. 

If you enjoy platformers, classic style 2D art with a modern flare, Torii is ready for you!
